Overview
Still being made today, the Porsche Panamera has consistently delivered as a luxury sporting GT car ever since its inception back in 2009. Ticking all of the boxes one would expect from such a model manufactured by as prestigious an auto maker as Porsche, the full-size, four-door Panamera is a subtly handsome and practical grand tourer that has more than enough performance whichever powertrain you decide to choose, and most who get behind the wheel are instantly smitten with just how good these cars are to drive.
Available with a selection of V6 and V8 engines, either naturally aspirated or with forced induction, as well as plug-in hybrid options, an earlier Panamera makes for an excellent used proposition in today's market, providing all of the bells and whistles of a modern motor but without the inflated price tag of a brand spanker. Cars like this particular 2011 Panamera 4 for example.
Being the 4, the car comes with Porsche's venerable 3.6-litre V6 which produces 300bhp powering all four wheels utilising the Porsche Traction Management system via, in this case, a seven-speed PDK automatic gearbox, which means a highly respectable 0-60mph time of 5.8 seconds and a top speed of 159mph. Plenty then.
With just two owners from new and complete with Porsche main dealer service history the car has been used sparingly by its current owner and the odometer reads just 38K miles as a result. That's not to say this Porsche has been left wanting though as a long, advisory-free MOT until November 2026 will attest, further evincing the car's cherished and well-maintained nature.
Well-presented throughout and packed with equipment, the vendor informs us that they have never driven the car in the rain and it has been stored under cover for the last 10 months due to an unfortunate motorcycle injury, re-emerging recently for a full specialist gearbox service to the tune of over £2.5K, along with that fresh MOT.

Summary
A consummately capable grand tourer, the Panamera has become one of Porsche's defining offerings and this fully loaded V6 all-wheel drive 4 is an eminently usable example. Luxurious, practical and wonderfully refined with more than enough performance without getting into the thirstier and more expensive eight-cylinder territory, it's a great representation of the marque. In all this is a fully-loaded, low mileage car with a strong history that can be driven and enjoyed straight away.
To arrange a viewing, click the 'Book Viewing' button located under the 'Place Bid' button. Viewings can be booked up until the day before the auction ends, after which the option will change to 'Contact Seller' for further enquiries. This seller is located in Tamworth, Staffordshire.
